edges.reason: Both sources report the death toll as eight people.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, The Wall Street Journal reported “An American has been charged with aiding Canadian Jesse Van Rootselaar in the February mass shooting that left eight people dead, including a schoolteacher and five students.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “Canadian police have identified the suspect in this year’s massacre of eight people – including her mother and half-brother, as well as the six children, making it the second-deadliest school shooting in the country’s history – as Jesse Van Rootselaar, who has a history of mental health problems.”.
